Q1: compares native iBGP, migration-retained (remote=65000, migration=65010), and migration-legacy (remote=65010, migration=65010), asserting real ingress installs third-party AS_PATH and LOCAL_PREF 231 unchanged, live reflection transmits them without eBGP prepend plus exact ORIGINATOR_ID and CLUSTER_LIST, and non-client-to-non-client forwarding returns an error and emits zero wire bytes. Q2: treating either migration identity as eBGP fails ingress first-AS/LOCAL_PREF checks, adds eBGP AS prepend or omits RFC 4456 reflection attributes, or leaks bytes past the non-client split-horizon gate. Q3: FinalAccept on the negative fixture ensures suppression comes solely from iBGP split horizon, while third-party first AS and LOCAL_PREF 231 isolate iBGP ingress/egress semantics. Q4: covers ingress installation, reflection, and split horizon across both migration identities and native iBGP.
